entity: PPHEpisode (one per declaration; child of Delivery or CaesareanRecord; may also hang on a gynae stay for secondary PPH)
design_rule: PAPER-FIRST at the bedside. The app offers (a) 'Declare PPH' one-tap from the patient banner which stamps declaration_time and starts the clock, and (b) a transcription screen laid out exactly like OBG-F-07 for entry within 24 h with the paper scanned and attached. Live entry during the event is optional, never required.

loss_method.note: 'estimated' counts against the KPI 'measured blood loss recorded'

shock_index_at_declaration.computed: pulse / systolic from the latest MEOWS or entered here

emotive_bundle.note: each item is a boolean with a time; 'within 15 min of declared_at' computed per item

O_carboprost_doses.contraindication_check: asthma flag on patient → warning, not block

T_txa_1g_at.rule: within 3 h of birth; warning if later

emotive_bundle.E_escalated: boolean (set automatically when any escalation field below is filled)

triggers: blood bank massive-transfusion pack request record

observation_rows.repeat: every 5–15 min until stable; each row = {time, pulse, bp, rr, spo2, urine_ml, cumulative_loss_ml, crystalloid_ml, colloid_ml, products[], temp, notes}

products.source: blood bank issue records when Build 16+/PX-OBG-16 exists; manual entry until then

paper_scan.required_if: any field entered > 60 min after clinical time (transcription)

automations.when: total_loss_ml >= 1500 OR (prbc + ffp + platelets + cryo) >= 4 OR hysterectomy_at OR disposition in [icu, transferred, death]
then: create OBG-F-19 near-miss record pre-filled (criteria ticked)
banner clock on the patient: minutes since declaration

automations.when: carboprost dose entered with < 15 min since previous OR 9th dose

then: record created for blood bank pack request with time

automations.then: compute KPI fields below and lock

computed_for_kpi.second_uterotonic_within_15_min: earliest of (carboprost[0], ergometrine, misoprostol) - declared_at <= 15 min
computed_for_kpi.bundle_complete_15_min: txa_within_15_min AND second_uterotonic_within_15_min AND I_iv_access_x2_at within 15 min AND O_oxytocin_infusion_at within 15 min

kpi_feeds.indicator: Births with measured blood loss recorded
PPH with TXA + second uterotonic within 15 min
Severe PPH ≥1500 / transfusion ≥4 units / peripartum hysterectomy per 1000

print.layout: A4 portrait exactly as OBG-F-07: header, E-MOTIVE three-column tick-with-time block, observations table, labs/outcome

acceptance_tests: Declare at 02:10, TXA 02:20, carboprost 02:22 → both 'within 15 min' true
Total loss 1600 ml saved → F-19 pre-filled, Lead notified, episode appears in M&M list
9th carboprost entry refused; 2nd dose at +10 min refused
Ergometrine entry on a patient with pre-eclampsia flag shows warning (not block)
Transcribed entries show 'late entry' and require the paper scan before consultant sign-off
